scholarships.title: TOP200 NAWA Programme
scholarships.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)

existing.description: TOP200 NAWA is an initiative of the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange that attracts outstanding research talent from universities ranked in the global top 200 to Polish universities and research institutes, offering stable full-time employment for two to four years so that the researcher can build their own research team. It runs two tracks, Junior Fellow for early-stage researchers whose doctorate is no more than seven years old and Senior Fellow for researchers experienced in leading research teams, is open to all scientific fields, and is funded from a call budget of PLN 17 million. The pilot call closed on 27 February 2026 with results due by 31 July 2026 and projects running from 2026 to 2032.
eligibility: Junior Fellow track: doctorate obtained no earlier than 7 years before the application deadline
Senior Fellow track: experience in leading research teams
Affiliation with a university ranked 1 to 200 in the Shanghai, QS or THE rankings
Open to all fields of science
existing.eligibility_summary: Two tracks by career stage: Junior Fellow for early-stage researchers who obtained their doctorate no earlier than seven years before the application deadline, and Senior Fellow for accomplished researchers with experience in leading research teams. The talent is attracted from universities ranked 1 to 200 in the Shanghai, QS or THE global rankings, and the programme is open to all fields of science.
benefits: Full-time employment contract in Poland for 2 to 4 years
Research infrastructure and administrative support from the host
coverage: Full-time employment contract for the Junior Fellow or Senior Fellow at the host institution
Access to suitable research infrastructure and administrative support
Assistance in adaptation and integration with the host staff
Call budget of PLN 17 million from NAWA
application_method: Applications follow the published TOP200 NAWA call; call documents are published on the programme page under 'Dokumenty do pobrania'
NAWA identifies researchinpoland.org as the recommended platform for finding a supervisor or host institution
existing.notes: The programme is named after Professor Rudolf Weigl. NAWA states the pilot call outcomes will be evaluated and will inform the Ministry of Science and Higher Education's decision on whether to continue the programme.
existing.duration: 2 to 4 years of full-time employment at a Polish university or research institute; the project implementation window is 2026 to 2032
existing.application_period: The pilot call closed on 27 February 2026 with results due by 31 July 2026; NAWA describes the programme as a pilot whose outcomes will inform whether it continues
existing.deadline_display: Submission deadline: February 27, 2026. Evaluation result by July 31, 2026.
existing.program_type: Research employment programme attracting global research talent to Poland
